what_happened: Held source found for the recalled Rabin citation: Thomas 1997 'Languages, Automata, and Logic' Theorem 6.20 (Rabin Tree Theorem, S2S decidable), Theorem 6.19 (MSO -> Muller tree automaton, effective), Theorem 6.18 (Rabin Basis Theorem, emptiness decidable + regular tree witness), plus the explicit countable-branching-into-binary-tree embedding in section 6.3. This closes dispatch item 3 for the main citation without a web fetch.

Report 866 finding 5 claims countability survives for the open modals by indexing witnesses by (walk, time, subformula). That claim is itself an instance of G1: the walks of the induced sub-digraph are uncountable, so the closure is not countable-to-countable. The repaired step 1 is state-indexed and does not extend to the open modals. Recorded as a correction rather than a blocker.

The two lemmas that repair G1 are already compiled in this repository and were simply not cited by report 03 section 1.3 step 1: PlusTruth.stab_state_only (line 332, box-dot truth depends on the world state alone) and PlusTruth.box_global (line 372, box truth is one bit per model), plus plusTruthAt_timeShift (line 264) and the compiled carrier normalisation plusValidZTime_iff_plusValidInt. G1 was a defect in the stated justification, not in the construction.

Task 870's stated hypothesis, 'directed paths between any two nodes are unique', may be strictly weaker than what report 03 section 1.2's step 4 actually consumes: that step uses the undirected tree path between two nodes and its unique sink, which needs the underlying undirected graph to be a forest. Flagged for task 870's plan so it states the oriented-forest hypothesis rather than only directed-path uniqueness.

FrameOver.IsRegular bundles TaskFrame.Saturation as a fourth field, so the compiled plus_invariance_of_isZTime requires BOTH frames to satisfy Saturation. This forced a reordering of the argument: the cover must be taken FIRST and the countable-model step run inside the oriented forest (whose induced sub-digraphs are again oriented forests, hence again satisfy Saturation), rather than report 03's order of countable model first, cover second.

Research report 01 already carried the complete self-contained argument (G1 repair, G2 new-root coding, held Rabin/Craig citations, theorem with 7-item hypothesis list, negative results, open-modal verdict), so the plan phase reduced to propagation rather than discovery. Task 866's plan (specs/866_*/plans/01_record-verdict-and-file-r1.md) supplied a directly reusable propagation-plan template for the same report-03 target.

Task 866's plan asserted in two Tier Justification lines that specs/ROADMAP.md resolves to __FULL_SWEEP__ under suite_selection_select, i.e. that no suite covers it. Measured directly this dispatch: suite_selection_select specs/ROADMAP.md returns 'test-engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh test-roadmap-generation.sh'. Only the report-03 path returns the sentinel. This plan's ROADMAP phase therefore names run-all.sh --only with those two suites rather than repeating the precedent's inaccurate sentinel claim.

The paper theorem is conditional on hypothesis (H5), owned by task 870 (status not_started). Worse, 870's stated hypothesis ('directed paths between any two nodes are unique') is strictly weaker than what report 03 section 1.2 step 4 actually consumes (the underlying UNDIRECTED graph must be a forest, for the tree path between a_m and a' and its unique sink). If 870 lands at its stated strength it will not discharge (H5). Research decision 7 flagged this; this plan propagates the flag into report 03 section 1.2 and the ROADMAP annotation on 870 so 870's owner reads it through both channels, rather than mutating another task's record.

plan-format.md's Verification Tiers section names the suite-subset entry point as 'bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh --only SUITE'. That path does not exist in this repository (a deploy target, not the source store: .claude-extensions.json carries no top-level source_dir, only per-extension ones). The working entry point here is bash .claude/scripts/tests/run-all.sh --only ..., which supports --only and holds both suites test-roadmap-generation.sh and test-engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh. Caught by checking the path instead of copying the doc's invocation into the plan; Phase 3's tier justification and verification criteria name the deployed entry point.

Report 866's finding 5 amendment (Phase 2) corrects the open-modal countability claim to negative, but report 866's own Decisions item 1/3 and Recommendations R2/R3 (written before this correction) still describe the L^▷ MSO route's verdict as positive-with-an-amendment and recommend keeping it as a paper result. The plan scoped this phase to finding 5 only (verification criteria explicitly bars touching finding 6 or other sections), so this inconsistency within report 866 is left standing rather than repaired here; flagged for a future reader or revision of 866.

Phase 4's validate-artifact.sh check on this task's own report (01_lplus-ztime-decidability-proof-repair.md, produced in the research dispatch, seq 1) failed: missing required '## Recommendations' section per report-format.md. Not listed in any phase's Files-to-modify, but the plan's own Phase 4 verification criterion requires validate-artifact.sh to exit 0 on all three reports. Added a minimal Recommendations section (R1: revise 870's hypothesis to oriented-forest strength; R2: optional typst chapter write-up, not filed) between the existing Decisions and Risks & Mitigations sections -- content only restates what Phase 4's own task 6 already names as follow-up proposals. validate-artifact.sh now passes on all three reports.

All three phase-1 wave propagation edits (report 03 amendment, report 866 finding-5 correction, ROADMAP.md four-sentence answer) landed as purely additive diffs on the first attempt, each validated by validate-artifact.sh / the roadmap test suite with no rework needed. The six cross-record guardrails (machine-checked, unconditional-on-H5, finite-model-property, Lean-formalization-reopened, decidableValidZTime-covers-stab, Base/Dense/RTime-open) all held on audit with zero violations found in the added hunks. verify-deploy.sh's full gate set passed (15 checks, 0 failures) with one pre-existing, unrelated WARN (lean hard_contracts migration).

git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'specs/878_lplus_ztime_decidability_paper_proof_repair/reports/01_lplus-ztime-decidability-proof-repair.md' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
